note: Extracted verbatim from the SeedQR specification and cross-checked against the BIP-39 English wordlist and checksum. standard: 4-digit zero-padded word indices (QR numeric mode, ECC L). compact: BIP-39 entropy without checksum bits, hex (QR byte mode, ECC L). Versions per the specification: 12 words -> standard 2 / compact 1; 24 words -> standard 3 / compact 2.
